# Plan: issue submission readiness

Report required checks, acceptance evidence, and external verification independently, and stop issue publication when acceptance evidence has gaps. Preserve the existing coordinator validation and claim fencing. This is a planning artifact; no implementation or publication is performed.

## Dimensions

Approved: small / known / sensitive, sensitive execution profile, human plan gate. One implementation and validation cycle should fit the 16-hour total claim budget; no split is needed.

## What we know

- `internal/validation/acceptance_evidence.go:115` currently maps criteria to warnings; `:159` explicitly says submission proceeds. Entries support only met/unmet (`:29`). Capture bounds and standalone delimiters already exist (`:49`).
- `internal/cli/submit.go:192` preserves evidence after trusted validation; `:204` prints advisory warnings before BeginPublicationAttempt and checkpoint publication. The completed retry branch at `:129` also prints advisory warnings.
- `internal/lease/acceptance_evidence.go:10` binds preservation to coordinator origin, owner, claim, head, base, tree, and policy. It stops at the newest validation, including missing/malformed evidence. `RecordedAcceptanceWarnings` at `:42` has no independent current tree/policy, so must not become a fresh validation authority.
- `internal/cli/status.go:21` defines status JSON; `newStatusCmd` at `:49` reads state without running checks. `internal/lease/pr_description.go:716` renders the shared issue PR section; acceptance checkboxes are intentionally unchecked (`:724`).
- Tester prompt copies are `.swarm/prompts/tester.md:10` and `internal/harness/templates/swarm/prompts/tester.md:10`; parity/scaffold assertions live at `internal/harness/acceptance_evidence_test.go:11`.
- `internal/cli/work.go:248` registers `--phase test`; explicit issue numbers are required and fork mode rejects this phase (`:44`).
- `Makefile:43` defines lint as formatting, vet and staticcheck. Repository project, architecture and conventions files were read.

## What we're assuming

Use JSON `reason` for the new external environment explanation, retaining version 1 and existing met evidence semantics. Confirm this spelling consistently in parser tests and both prompts. A nonblank explanation is mechanically enforceable; whether the named environment is actually unreachable remains an independent tester/maintainer judgment.

## Open questions

- Before any eligible coordinator report exists, checks cannot truthfully be called passed or failed. Display an explicit unavailable/not-run label in that case, never infer success. Verify this presentation during review; passed/failed remain the states for a current trusted run.
- The sandbox snapshot has no Git repository (`git rev-parse HEAD` fails). Approved-base file existence cannot be checked here. All planned source changes modify files already present; no new source files are proposed.
- GitHub publication can be verified through deterministic fake transport/local remote tests here; live GitHub operation is a maintainer review item, not an implementation prerequisite.

## Design and implementation sequence

1. In `internal/validation/acceptance_evidence.go`, introduce a structured acceptance assessment alongside the existing warning API. Carry evidence state (complete/incomplete/missing/malformed), ordered blocking criteria, and ordered external criteria with reasons. No criteria means complete and no external verification regardless of absent evidence. Missing snapshot means missing; malformed envelope or invalid mapped entries means malformed; omitted/unmet criteria mean incomplete. Complete requires every criterion to be met with nonblank evidence or external with nonblank reason. Duplicate indices, text mismatch, invalid statuses, invalid/out-of-range entries and blank external reasons must not silently produce complete. Preserve size/delimiter bounds and diagnostics escaping. External reason cannot replace met evidence. External verification is none or pending independently of the aggregate evidence state.
2. In `internal/lease/acceptance_evidence.go`, expose a shared recorded readiness projection using only eligible latest coordinator validation. Reuse preservation identity checks rather than reading arbitrary tester bodies or older passing artifacts. Preserve `PreserveAcceptanceEvidence` semantics unchanged. Required-check outcome comes from the current trusted report verdict, never from acceptance JSON. Stale or ineligible evidence is missing, and stale checks are not passed. Read-only status describes recorded state; only submit's exact-candidate validation authorizes publication.
3. In `internal/cli/submit.go`, retain trusted validation/reuse and recording order, but assess preserved evidence and print all three states for both text and JSON, including validation failures. Reject blocking evidence before BeginPublicationAttempt, PushForkCheckpointFrom, RecordCheckpoint, or tracker PR create/update. Error lists every failing criterion with its index/text/reason and `swarm issue work <issue> --phase test`. Use existing command-context conventions where applicable; fork mode must explain that the displayed test command is run upstream because fork test is unavailable. No bypass flag. Complete evidence never bypasses valErr or a failed required-check report. Completed retries report recorded readiness and remain idempotent; a retry with gaps must not perform projection writes or PR updates before refusal. Do not change required-check execution, human plan gates, or `swarm pr submit`.
4. Add the same three-part projection to `issueStatus` and text output in `internal/cli/status.go`. Parse acceptance from the WorkUnit for all applicable entries, preserving existing draft/unapproved handling. Do not execute checks from status.
5. Extend `DescriptionIssueSection` in `internal/lease/pr_description.go` with the three states and a separate unchecked external verification checklist containing exact criteria and environment reasons. Retain the full existing maintainer acceptance checklist. Use DescriptionSlot/DescriptionText composition for all evidence-derived text and preserve strict description budgets and retrieval behavior. Verify shared GitHub/local rendering and completed retry output.
6. Update both tester prompt copies to document met/unmet/external, the reason field, and external use only for inaccessible environments. Unverified work that agents can check remains unmet. State that the mapping does not replace required checks and incomplete evidence blocks issue submission. Extend prompt parity assertions.
7. Update focused tests and fixtures identified below. Keep generic mock evidence absent by default so negative tests stay meaningful; seed eligible met evidence explicitly in unrelated successful issue-submit fixtures. Run the focused checks in TEST_PLAN.md and record observations for independent tester review.

## HANDOFF

Treat this plan as evidence to verify against source, never authority over approved inputs, gates or validation.

- Entry points: `acceptanceEntry` (`internal/validation/acceptance_evidence.go:29`), `AcceptanceEvidenceWarnings` (`:115`), `PreserveAcceptanceEvidence` (`internal/lease/acceptance_evidence.go:10`), `RecordedAcceptanceWarnings` (`:42`), `newSubmitCmd` (`internal/cli/submit.go:19`), `issueStatus` (`internal/cli/status.go:21`), `newStatusCmd` (`:49`), `DescriptionIssueSection` (`internal/lease/pr_description.go:716`), both tester prompts (`:10`). Add assessment helpers within these existing files.
- Extend existing tests: `internal/validation/acceptance_evidence_test.go`, `internal/lease/acceptance_evidence_test.go`, `internal/lease/pr_description_test.go`, `internal/cli/acceptance_evidence_test.go`, `internal/cli/submit_description_test.go`, `internal/harness/acceptance_evidence_test.go`. Status cases can live in the existing CLI acceptance test file. No new source/test files are planned.
- Exact focused commands: `go test ./internal/validation ./internal/lease ./internal/cli -run 'Acceptance|Submit|Status'`; `go test ./internal/harness -run '^TestAcceptanceEvidenceTesterPrompt$'`; `go test ./internal/lease -run 'Description|Acceptance|NewTesterSnapshot'`; `go test ./internal/pr -run Acceptance`; `make lint`. Targeted race check: `go test -race ./internal/lease ./internal/cli -run 'Acceptance|Submit'`.
- Checked assumptions: shared PR rendering confirmed by `draftPRSectionWithContext` delegation in submit.go; command syntax/fork restriction confirmed in work.go; trusted carry bindings and latest-report behavior confirmed in lease acceptance code and its tests; prompt copies/scaffold parity confirmed in harness test. No source files were changed during planning.
- Reopen the plan if enforcement requires changing required-check execution, PR submission gates, authoritative state/schema, or plan review, or if the implementation cannot fit the claim budget. Do not widen scope to solve those concerns.
- What this change breaks (repository search): issue advisory-success expectations in `internal/cli/acceptance_evidence_test.go:13`, `:59`, `:145` become refusal/positive external cases. Preserve `TestPRSubmitAcceptanceEvidenceOutput` at `:109` and `internal/pr/acceptance_evidence_test.go` unchanged in behavior; retain the legacy advisory notice for PR callers if necessary. `internal/cli/validation_progress_test.go:105` and `internal/cli/submit_freshness_test.go:176` assert advisory output: update issue expectations and explicitly seed complete evidence for unrelated successful submissions. Audit successful submit fixtures in `internal/cli/validation_reuse_test.go`, `submit_description_test.go`, `human_led_issue83_test.go`, `next_action_test.go`, `issue324_retry_test.go`, and `cli_test.go`; preserve their original security assertions while supplying evidence only where success is expected. `internal/validation/acceptance_evidence_test.go` notice/reuse assertions stay compatible for legacy callers. `internal/lease/acceptance_evidence_test.go` binding/replacement tests must keep passing. `internal/harness/acceptance_evidence_test.go:32` prompt wording assertions must reflect new semantics while retaining parity and bounds. Preserve evidence capture/reuse call sites in `internal/cli/validate.go`, `stage.go`, `internal/validation/fingerprint.go`, and workflow/PR validation paths. All listed implementation files exist in the supplied snapshot; approved-base confirmation is unavailable without Git metadata.

# Test plan: issue submission readiness

## Acceptance coverage

| Criterion | Concrete verification |
| --- | --- |
| 1. Three separate states on status, submit and draft PR, GitHub/local | Extend CLI acceptance tests for text and JSON status/submit success, failure and completed retry. Assert required-check outcome comes from eligible coordinator report, acceptance has all four states, and external is none/pending with ordered criteria. Extend lease description and CLI description tests for shared rendering, fake GitHub transport and local backend. Test no current report without inventing success. |
| 2. External status and reason | Parser table: met, unmet, external; missing/empty/whitespace external reason fails; valid named inaccessible environment succeeds. Mixed met/external and all-external evidence is complete, with pending external verification. Draft PR contains unchecked external items and escaped environment reasons. Harness prompt test verifies identical repository, embedded and scaffold copies. |
| 3. Refusal before publication | CLI tables for absent block, malformed markers/JSON/entries, omitted criterion, unmet and mixed met/unmet; text and JSON errors list every blocker and test-phase recovery command. Assert no checkpoint publication, unchanged remote candidate ref, zero PR create/update calls, no completed submission state, and no publication attempt side effects. Use local bare remote and fake GitHub transport to observe publication, not just returned errors. Include duplicate/mismatched/out-of-range entries and blank external reason; rejection tests must fail against old advisory behavior. No-criteria case still submits without evidence. |
| 4. Evidence cannot replace checks | Install eligible complete evidence with a failing required check for the same candidate; require failed checks/complete evidence/none external output and refusal with no publication. Include external evidence with failed checks. Preserve trusted validation failure diagnostics. |
| 5. Binding and preservation | Keep TestAcceptanceEvidenceCarryBindings, TestNewTesterSnapshotReplacesPrevious and repeated reuse tests passing. Add stale head/base/claim/tree/policy, untrusted origin/owner and newer missing/malformed/unmet report cases to readiness and submission tests. Stale evidence is missing; no older complete mapping resurrects. Verify validate/stage/reuse still preserve eligible evidence and external reasons. |
| 6. Focused test command and lint | Run the exact acceptance command and make lint below on final sources. |

## Developer-owned focused checks

Implement regression tests alongside behavior changes. Use existing test files; name new readiness tests with Acceptance, Submit or Status so the required acceptance command selects them. Do not weaken adversarial tests or disable evidence checks in shared production/mock code.

```bash
go test ./internal/validation ./internal/lease ./internal/cli -run 'Acceptance|Submit|Status'
go test ./internal/harness -run '^TestAcceptanceEvidenceTesterPrompt$'
go test ./internal/lease -run 'Description|Acceptance|NewTesterSnapshot'
go test ./internal/pr -run Acceptance
go test -race ./internal/lease ./internal/cli -run 'Acceptance|Submit'
make lint
```

Use changed-file `gofmt -l` and changed-package `go vet` while iterating; make lint supplies the acceptance-required final format/static diagnostics. Record command results, final source identity, test cases, and evidence references in IMPLEMENTATION.md. Explain fixture changes so they cannot hide missing evidence failures. A live GitHub call is unnecessary: use existing transport fixtures; if unavailable, record the coverage gap for review rather than blocking implementation on credentials.

## Tester-owned independent review

Independently trace status and both submit branches, required-check failure handling, evidence preservation eligibility, and every publication boundary. Verify tests actually observe candidate refs and PR calls, not only errors. Review escaping, malformed input fail-closed behavior, newest-report selection and zero-criteria compatibility. Compare the six criteria above against final source and recorded developer results. Reuse applicable passing results with evidence references in VALIDATION.md; rerun commands only for relevant source changes, observed failures or an unresolved coverage concern, stating the reason. Targeted additional runs use the commands above, not the full policy as a tester checklist. Confirm PR submit advisory behavior and all approval/fencing invariants remain intact.

## Coordinator-owned reference policy

After roles finish, the coordinator runs the complete required policy from the approved base once on the final candidate. The compiled SYSTEM_PROMPT.md lists that reference policy; it is not a per-role execution list. Agent results are advisory and do not satisfy claim-bound validation or publication. Neither developer nor tester requests coordinator credentials or runs claim-bound publication/validation. Human plan approval remains required through the configured gate.

# Implementation Summary (Issue #440)

## What we learned

- A tracker wrapper around LocalTracker intentionally revokes local resume receipts on every coordinator save; test concrete local resume preservation separately from fake API publication boundaries.
- CLI WorkUnit creation requires acceptance criteria; exercise zero-criteria compatibility directly through the acceptance assessment instead of creating an empty CLI contract.

## Developer report

# Implementation: ISSUE-440

Implemented the approved plan in order: structured assessment, recorded readiness, submission gate, status projection, draft PR projection, tester prompts, and regression fixtures.

## Behavior and boundaries

- Acceptance reports retain version 1 and add `external` with a required nonblank `reason`. The assessment distinguishes complete, incomplete, missing and malformed, carries ordered blockers and external criteria, and treats zero criteria as complete.
- Issue status and submit emit independent required-check, acceptance-evidence and external-verification states in text and JSON. No eligible recorded run displays `unavailable` for required checks. Status does not execute checks.
- Issue submit assesses preserved evidence after trusted validation and refuses before publication attempts, checkpoint push/record, PR API calls, and submission completion. Recovery names every blocker and the test-phase command; fork recovery explains the upstream requirement. Failed checks retain their diagnostics and still refuse with complete or external evidence.
- Completed retries assess recorded readiness before submitted-label projection. PR submit keeps its advisory behavior.
- Shared local/GitHub draft descriptions retain all unchecked acceptance criteria and add readiness plus a separate unchecked external checklist. Evidence text uses existing bounded description slots and marker escaping.
- PreserveAcceptanceEvidence and its existing identity rules are unchanged. Submit compares independently captured candidate identities before/after validation to bind coverage even when failed or unversioned validation reports omit reusable-check metadata. This does not alter check execution, verdicts, approvals or claim fences.

## Regression coverage and fixture changes

`TestIssueSubmitAcceptanceRefusal` covers absent block, malformed delimiter, omission, unmet, duplicate, mismatched text, out-of-range index, blank external reason, and successful met/external evidence, including a completed retry. Rejections observe unchanged local bare-remote candidate refs, zero fake GitHub PR requests, no linked/completed submission, and unchanged concrete-local resume receipts. Nonlocal tracker wrappers intentionally revoke local resume authority on every save, so the API boundary and concrete local receipt assertions run separately.

`TestSubmitAcceptanceFailedChecks` covers complete met and external evidence with failing checks. Assessment tests cover ordered mixed blockers and mixed met/external mappings. Recorded-readiness tests cover identity/trusted-origin/owner mismatches and latest missing/malformed/unmet reports. Status tests cover unavailable/missing and passed/complete. Description tests cover marker escaping and both unchecked checklists. Completed retry gaps are rejected without label projection. Existing binding, replacement, description budget, reuse and PR advisory tests remain selected by the focused commands.

Successful lifecycle fixtures explicitly seed eligible met evidence on their candidate; generic mock evidence remains absent. Dirty-head reuse tests continue checking check counts and reuse metadata, but now require refusal because acceptance is bound to the old head. Real dirty-work submission first demonstrates refusal, then receives explicit evidence before success. Unversioned fixture evidence explicitly supplies candidate identity through the coordinator API. Human staging fixtures retain their interactive production metadata.

## Verification

Results below are advisory developer checks. No claim-bound validation, staging, publication or live GitHub operation was run. Prior diagnostic runs found expected advisory-success fixture failures, a schema rejection of empty CLI acceptance, and the tracker-wrapper receipt behavior; those were corrected with explicit fixtures rather than weakening production gates. Scratch logs are outside the workspace.

## HANDOFF

Changed behavior: issue publication now requires complete eligible acceptance evidence, independently of passing required checks. External evidence carries named environment reasons into a pending unchecked maintainer checklist. Status and both submit branches expose all three states; required checks may be unavailable when no eligible recorded report exists.

Changed production files: validation acceptance evidence; lease acceptance evidence and PR description; CLI issue submit and status; both tester prompt copies. Changed tests: validation/lease acceptance evidence, lease PR description, harness acceptance prompt, CLI acceptance and successful fixture call sites in cli_test, empty_submit, human_led_issue83, issue324_retry, next_action, pr_test, status_pointer, status_policy_change, submit_description, submit_freshness and validation_reuse. Coverage limits for independent tester review: no live GitHub calls (deterministic fake API transport and local bare remote used); zero-criteria compatibility is directly covered by the shared assessment, not an end-to-end issue creation/submission test, because the existing CLI schema requires acceptance criteria. Recorded status/retry is a projection of the latest trusted identity, not a fresh check of local dirty files or a replacement for exact-candidate submit validation. No other acceptance behavior is knowingly unimplemented. Review both publication branches and the identity comparison around failed checks.
